ORAL ORDER 2 06-03-2025 Heard Mr. Anil Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the appellant and the State.
2. The present appeal has been filed:
against the judgment and order of sentence dated 06.12.2023 passed by the Learned 13th Additional Sessions Judge, Bhojpur at Ara in Sessions Trial No. (S.Tr.No.) 121 of 2018 arising out of Complaint Case No.2253(C) of 2015 by which the learned trial court has been pleased to convict the appellants and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for R.I. of two year and fine of Rs.5000/- of the appellants for the offence committed Under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code

sentences.text: and also directed in default of payment of fine undergo R.I. of one month, the learned trial Patna High Court CR.
